text:
Palladium Price in 2019
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2019, the LBMA palladium price rose 38.0% between 2019-01-31 ($1,380) and 2019-12-30 ($1,905). The highest sampled price was $1,905 in December and the lowest was $1,366 in April. The mean of these observations was $1,571. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
